recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy photograph of a shirtless figure in a dynamic, leaning pose against a deep blue twilight sky featuring a small moon, topped with bold, compressed red sans-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red title vs. deep blue sky background
Extreme low-angle perspective emphasizing the figure's muscularity
Heavy film grain texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
The small, bright moon acting as a secondary focal point to balance the figure's lean
coreInvariants: Heavy digital or film grain overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The figure is positioned centrally but leaning heavily to the left, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The muscular back of the figure serves as the primary anchor, while the red text anchors the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red text, follows the figure's lean downward to the right, and is pulled back by the moon on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides significant negative space, though it is heavily textured with noise.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text against a medium-value, textured blue background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, blue, black, and white

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard compressed geometric forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family dominance with small metadata blocks in the corner.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style metadata block in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a shirtless man with dreadlocks leaning back against a grainy, deep blue twilight sky with a small moon visible. Apply a heavy film grain effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, extra-condensed red sans-serif text across the top. Place a small black and white advisory logo in the bottom right corner.
